msg: Hi thank you for reading. The first important point is that gnomes come in pairs. Note that the gnomes size, hat and position is irrelevant. What important is guessing that which colour is giving more points in each session. Such as lets say in one session after selecting both dark and bright colour forest I felt like that dark forest was giving more points so I mainly went with that.Then in second session I felt like this time bright forest was giving more points so I selected gnomes that took me to bright forest. You have to guess which forest giving more points but that also not works everytime.
